reviewer.role: Independent archive and delivery-document reviewer; no archive or delivery-document authorship

scope: Actual completed cumulative Version14 archive built from source S3, actual build/restoration evidence, and exact seven rendered Markdown/JSON delivery documents. Reuses accepted frozen-source, release-input and collection review; no new mathematical audit.

build.observation: Root reported terminal completion; independently read completed RUN.json, runner and actual outputs. The reviewed runner invokes the hash-pinned packager; the packager writes final archive/logs/receipt only after all four required replay commands return zero.

checks.name: Archive and frozen source identity
checks.detail: Independently hashed all 9,894 ZIP members according to the exact manifest membership; archive size and SHA-256 match the receipt. All 9,881 current file hashes equal the selected map; each current file also independently matches its Git blob identity at source S3, not merely a working-tree file.

checks.name: Historical preservation
checks.detail: Recursively verified every member and manifest of the unchanged Version13, Version12, Version11, Version10 and Version9 layers. Checked safe names, duplicate/case collisions and nonregular entries. An in-memory reconstruction contains 9,889 files: all 9,881 current selected files plus seven older PDF files and the exact Version13 archive. The source map deliberately covers the selected layer; historical extras are retained, not silently counted as new selected files.

checks.name: Release contracts
checks.detail: The hash-matched reviewed contract code was applied to actual ZIP bytes without building or replaying. All 39 required members, 231 coverage/profile/evidence rows, three governing/historical protocol hashes, the research-annex integrity checks, exact project-PDF allowlist, source-map coverage/bytes, 237 release-input role pins, six post-gate files, package manifest, public download aliases and inventory-install members pass. The source map classifies 5,352 current and 4,529 historical files and retains 181 explicit exclusions.

checks.name: Actual restored checks
checks.detail: All four log SHA-256 values match the receipt. Log1 records successful restoration with historical bases; log2 passes history checks and negative controls; log3 records 39 applications, 24 assembly IRs, 351 obligations and five negative self-tests, explicitly structural-only; log4 passes the 28-stage lineage and the selected 299/314 coefficient/table checks. These are the completed build’s actual replay results, not a claim that this reviewer ran a second replay.

checks.name: Seven delivery documents
checks.detail: Compared each existing document with its exact S3 predecessor, read the changed claims in context and checked the seven final hashes. Archive size, SHA-256, S3 commit and receipt agree with actual bytes. The receipt is byte-identical to PACKAGE-RECEIPT.json. The documents distinguish the archived source revision from subsequent delivery documentation, retain historical/rejected status qualifications and do not treat finite checks as proofs. Protocol_D naming remains unchanged. All 121 relative Markdown link occurrences resolve against proposed documents or the repository after URL decoding. Release-asset URLs are intended publication destinations; this review does not claim that the new asset is already uploaded.

objection_history.classification: Premature delivery-check wording; no archive or source-mathematics defect
objection_history.original_sentence: Its own release check is attached to the delivery commit on GitHub; the source check does not approve a later commit.
objection_history.disposition: Author corrected the sentence; independently checked exact replacement
objection_history.replacement_sentence: The delivery commit requires its own release check on GitHub; the source check does not approve a later commit.

limits: No package rebuild, source modification or second restore/replay was performed.
The archive review adopts actual completed build replay logs and independently verifies bytes/contracts and in-memory layer composition.

This body can be included in a future delivery commit, but it is not an acknowledgment of any future commit, packet, binding, authenticated gate or publication. Actual delivery revision R is not yet supplied.
No frozen proof or previously accepted source-gate judgment was re-audited.
The seven rendered inputs are Markdown/JSON output files; no separate PDF/HTML browser rendering was supplied or visually audited.
